resources.string: TV: your TV handles Dolby Vision. Box, as HDR10: this box converts it to HDR10, for TVs that show HDR10 better.
Your TV receives Dolby Vision and handles it itself. The best picture on most Dolby Vision TVs.
This box converts Dolby Vision to HDR10 before sending it. For TVs whose Dolby Vision looks dim or wrong.
Starts with the next title. HDR10, HLG and SDR titles aren\'t changed.
